papers.title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
papers.summary: WorldLeague benchmarks 13 AI systems on 60 simulated robot tasks spanning exploration, rearrangement, and adaptation, measuring progress and success to compare autonomous physical goal achievement.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 73 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking
papers.summary: Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both interactive worlds and the tasks agents must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation (WD). World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors,…
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 25 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
papers.summary: A systematic framework shows that frontier multimodal models can serve as robot policies when harnessed with interfaces favoring native visual reasoning and tool use, achieving high success in simulated and real manipulation tasks.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 90 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
papers.summary: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To…
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 22 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood
papers.summary: A code localizer is trained with scores from a frozen fixer via weighted supervised fine-tuning, improving bug localization and patch success for a small coding agent without tests or reinforcement learning.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 52 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
papers.summary: Auditing reward labels in coding-agent reinforcement learning tasks shows many unsolved tasks are mislabeled, and training on corrected tasks improves policy performance on SWE-bench benchmarks.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.
